description: Asynchronous proofing (spell/grammar) provider consumed by TmDocumentEditor.ProofingProvider: the editor extracts the document plain text, calls CheckAsync after load and after edits (debounced), and materializes the returned issues into the word-list based DocumentProofingOptions that drive the canvas squiggle overlay and spelling context menu. A reference LanguageTool implementation ships in Tempo.Blazor.Proofing.LanguageTool.
